description:
Get IRS 990 filing summary and financial trends for a foundation.

This tool retrieves IRS 990 filing data (Form 990 or 990-PF) for a foundation,
showing financial information over time. It calculates year-over-year trends
for assets, grants, and revenue.

US 990 filers only. Pass ``ein`` (or a ``funder_id`` that resolves to an
EIN — a bare EIN or ``usf:<ein>``). ``search_funders`` returns ``funder_id``
on every hit, so the caller can hand it back here the way it does for the
other funder tools. Non-990 funders have no 990 filings — those return a
clean redirect to ``get_funder_stats(funder_id=...)`` rather than an error.

ein.description:
Foundation EIN (9 digits). Can include hyphens (e.g., "94-3136777")
 or be provided as digits only (e.g., "943136777"). Optional if
 ``funder_id`` is supplied.

funder_id.description:
Optional polymorphic funder id. A bare EIN or ``usf:<ein>``
 routes to the 990 path; a non-990 id (bare UUID / ``n9f:<uuid>`` /
 ``non990:<uuid>``) has no 990 filings and returns a redirect to
 get_funder_stats.

years.description: Number of years of filing data to return (1-10)

name: get_990_summary
title: Get IRS 990 Summary
